title: Emit the E-Document LLM calls under the Payables Agent copilot capability
summary: E-Document LLM calls designed for Payables Agent use are now routed through the Payables Agent app instead of the E-Document app to streamline billing feature management.
key_points: LLM calls specific to Payables Agent scenarios are moved from E-Document to Payables Agent app
New codeunit PADraftBasedCopilotCaller added to handle Payables Agent copilot calls
E-Document and E-Document MLLM Handler codeunits updated to support the routing change
Change aligns with dataplane request to simplify billing feature management
quote: Routing the calls done for the Payables Agent functionality that are done today in the E-Documents app via the Payables Agent app.
